_what: Per-platform capability matrix for TOS delivery: what an INDIVIDUAL teacher's account can actually run, as dated, sourced facts. Statuses: available | unavailable | unverified (never guessed). UNTESTED-live marks a vendor-documented capability no one has exercised on a real teacher account yet.
_why: User decision (R5): plan-gated capabilities are feature flags, not assumptions. Docs and tools/build_teacher_pack.py read THIS file; a vendor change is a one-line status flip here, and check 24 (dated manifests) plus tools/platform_watch.py keep it from rotting silently.
_rules: Every status carries source + checked. A claim without a vendor page is at best unverified. Sources verified by the 2026-09-25 research rounds (research-manager graded); the full research record is retained off-repo (delivered to the maintainer 2026-09-25), and every status stands on its inline source URL.

code_cli.note: Loader scans skill dirs ONE level deep; the manifest skills array (R5-A2) is what makes 62/62 load. Verified with claude plugin details 2.1.282. R8: plugin mcpServers runs the compiled tos-tools.mcpb release bundle — Connected with NO python/node/uv on PATH (tested, Claude Code 2.1.289). Claude Code does not supply Node and ignores uv-type bundles (tested).

desktop_chat.note: 'You can install and use plugins in chat on the web, the Chat tab in Claude Desktop, and Claude Cowork.' Plugin local MCP runs in Cowork/Code; .mcpb covers Desktop chat tools. Desktop >= v2.9939.2 for plugins containing a .zip. R8: the .mcpb is type 'binary' with per-OS platform_overrides (one universal2 macOS build) — nothing to install. Gatekeeper/SmartScreen behavior on a real Mac/PC: UNTESTED-live (R8 phase 5).

web_chat_paid.install: plugin via Customize (upload or GitHub marketplace)
web_chat_paid.note: 'A plugin's local MCP server runs in Cowork and Claude Code, not in chat.' Browser cannot reach localhost.

web_chat_free.install: Project file upload; 1 custom remote connector allowed
web_chat_free.note: Plugins are documented for paid plans only.

teachers_plan.note: UNTESTED-live. 'A free Claude for Teams plan' with Claude Code + Cowork; its disabled-features list does NOT include plugins/connectors/extensions — inference, not a statement. Training off. One free year for signups by 2027-06-30. District domain claims can absorb the account later.

desktop_workcodex_personal.install: local marketplace (~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json + ~/.codex/plugins/) or Settings > MCP servers > STDIO
desktop_workcodex_personal.note: UNTESTED-live end-to-end. Codex on every plan incl. Free/Go; Work on paid plans (desktop; staged rollout). openai/codex source: plugin stdio servers ARE spawned; ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is NOT expanded in MCP args (use the Agent-Plugins mcp.json with ${PLUGIN_ROOT}, or cwd '.'); manifest skills paths must start with './'; initialize offers 2025-06-18; Windows resolves commands PATHEXT-style, python3 is NOT mapped to python. R8: stays on Python — Codex expands ${PLUGIN_ROOT} only in args (command must be a bare token) and has no per-OS override, so a bundled executable cannot be named portably; Codex also needs the runtime on PATH (openai/codex#31897).

web_personal.install: Project + reference pack (25 files on Plus)
web_personal.note: 'Can I connect to a local MCP server? Not directly.' Web developer mode is Business/Enterprise/Edu. Custom GPTs retire 2026-12-11; personal plans already cannot create them.

teachers_plan.note: Weakest path. Skills + plugin upload/GitHub import are documented for Business/Enterprise/(Healthcare)/Edu, never Teachers; Codex pricing page omits Teachers; a Jan-2026 OpenAI-contributor comment said Codex 'isn't provided' there (possibly superseded). Free through June 2028, training off, self-serve workspace possible. OpenAI's own K-12 plugin: district-claimed workspaces only.

antigravity_personal.note: UNTESTED-live. Personal Google account, 18+, approved regions; NOT for school accounts. Free weekly quota. Client probes server/discover (2026-07-28) FIRST and needs -32601 to fall back (R5-A1 provides it). Terms allow interaction review/training unless Settings > Account > Telemetry is off — default not stated, tell teachers to check. R8: stays on Python — the pack installer is itself a Python script, so its users are already at Level 1; the compiled launcher adds nothing here.

gemini_cli.note: NOT FREE since 2026-06-18: personal/free tiers stopped being served; needs a paid API key or a school Code Assist Standard/Enterprise or Workspace AI Ultra licence. Loader glob ['SKILL.md','*/SKILL.md'].

gemini_app.install: Gem with <=10 knowledge files (upload-rule cap) or a Gemini Notebook source; Classroom Gem = 10 sources
gemini_app.note: Custom MCP 'apps' take a remote URL only (18+, US, English, personal accounts; not work/school). Personal accounts: Keep Activity on by default, human review + training — warn before student-adjacent use. School accounts: no review/training (edition-dependent).
